text: The girl is one of the girls that was selling shrimp. You could get a shrimp 6 - 7 niches long and a beer for 25 cents. Average pay of a Vietnamese was 10 cents a day.
researchNotes: The shrimp sellers of the Nha Trang beach huts, as in VN-0021/VN-0022. 'niches' is as typed and reads as inches; the text is left as given.
